title: Introducing eve 1.0
summary_en: Today we're announcing eve 1.0 , the open-source framework for building production-ready agents. Since the public preview in June , we've worked with early adopters to prepare eve for 1.0, shipping 230+ releases and merging thousands of pull requests. With this release, eve is now generally available. We've made eve faster, expanded integrations, and improved observability. Security controls let you decide which actions need approval and what data gets collected.
